@G.1 = external global half
@G.2 = external global i1
@G.3 = external global i1

declare void @foo(ptr)

declare void @bar(ptr)

declare dso_local i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

define void @caller(ptr %p) personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  %0 = icmp eq ptr %p, null
  br i1 %0, label %bb1, label %bb2

bb1:                                              ; preds = %entry
  %LGV = load half, ptr @G.1, align 2
  %C = fcmp ule half 1.000000e+00, %LGV
  store i1 %C, ptr @G.2, align 1
  invoke void @foo(ptr %p)
          to label %end1 unwind label %lpad

bb2:                                              ; preds = %entry
  invoke void @bar(ptr %p)
          to label %end2 unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %bb2, %bb1
  %1 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          cleanup
  call void @callee(ptr %p)
  resume { ptr, i32 } %1

end1:                                             ; preds = %bb1
  %B = and i1 true, %C
  store i1 %B, ptr @G.3, align 1
  ret void

end2:                                             ; preds = %bb2
  %2 = phi i1 [ false, %bb2 ]
  store i1 %2, ptr poison, align 1
  ret void
}

declare hidden void @callee(ptr)
